services.name: Convex
services.does: Hosts turtl's backend, database, and file storage

services.name: OpenAI
services.does: Names the parts of the code, diagnoses a problem, proposes fixes, answers questions, sorts customers' reports, and turns speech into text and text into speech

services.name: Supermemory
services.does: Finds the code and the past cases that matter to a question or a new problem
receives: Up to 30,000 characters of each source file

services.name: Capy
services.does: Writes an approved code change and opens a pull request
receives: The instructions for an approved code change
The repository itself, through Capy's own connection to GitHub

services.name: Keiki
services.does: Texts the owner when a case needs them
receives: A notice of one or two sentences, such as the app's name and a case title
The phone number alerts go to

services.name: GitHub
services.does: Holds the repository turtl reads, and the pull requests it follows and merges
receives: Requests to read the repository and its pull requests
A merge, when the owner taps Merge

services.name: Revyl
services.does: Runs the owner's app on a phone in its cloud to check a fix, and sends back screenshots
receives: The id of the test to run

services.name: The owner's own app
services.does: Answers turtl's health checks and carries out an approved recovery
receives: Health checks and the approved recovery action, signed with a control secret

otherHosts.ronoktanvir.github.io: turtl's own privacy, terms, and support pages, opened in the browser from the gear sheet
otherHosts.app.invalid: A placeholder address in a prompt. Nothing is sent to it
otherHosts.example.invalid: A placeholder address in developer sample data. Nothing is sent to it

otherSettings.VOICE_ENABLED: Switches talking on. Off by default
otherSettings.CODE_NETWORK_CHAT_ENABLED: Switches questions about the code on. Off by default
otherSettings.ASSISTANT_ENABLED: Switches the unused assistant function on. Keep it off
otherSettings.DEV_TOOLS_ENABLED: Switches the backend's developer tools on. Never set in production
otherSettings.EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_TOOLS: Shows the developer tools in the app. Never set in a store build
otherSettings.EXPO_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE: Set to example, the app shows example data and calls no backend
otherSettings.EXPO_PUBLIC_TURTL_INTAKE_URL: The demo app's report form: where it posts reports
otherSettings.EXPO_PUBLIC_TURTL_INTAKE_KEY: The demo app's report form: which app the report is for
otherSettings.TURTL_PREVIEW_ORIGIN: The address of a web preview, used when building one

libraries.@expo-google-fonts/capriola: The font, shipped inside the app. No request to Google
libraries.convex: The client for turtl's own backend
libraries.expo-audio: Records and plays audio after the owner taps Talk
libraries.expo-file-system: Reads the recording and deletes it; writes and deletes the spoken reply
libraries.expo-secure-store: Keeps the owner passcode in the iOS Keychain
libraries.react-dom: The UI library, for the web preview
libraries.react-native-svg: Draws icons and the map of the code
libraries.supermemory: The client for Supermemory, used only in the backend
